name: Kelden AdaptFlex Variable-Geometry Trouser
description: Slim-cut trousers in matte black synth-wool blend with memory-fiber panels at the thigh, knee, and calf that expand and contract to accommodate variable-geometry augmented limbs — legs that shift configuration between modes. The waistband and hip are cut generously, with internal adjustment cords. They look like a clean, professional pant at rest and reshape silently under movement.
functionality: Memory-fiber panels passively accommodate variable-geometry aug limbs through multiple configuration states without tearing or binding.
what_it_says: You have serious augmentation and the budget to dress around it properly.
worn_by: office workers with military-grade aug legs
mid-level corporate staff with aftermarket chrome
story_hooks: The memory-fiber panels retain a partial shape memory — a forensics tech can reconstruct what configuration a wearer's limb was in at a specific time.
Someone sold a counterfeit batch; the fake panels fail under rapid config cycling, seizing around the limb mid-transformation.

physical_description.visual_profile: Sleek, minimalist silhouette with a subtle architectural quality. Appears as a sharp professional pant in static form, but the thigh, knee, and calf regions show barely-perceptible dimensional quilting that hints at adaptive tech beneath. The overall impression is corpo-clean but engineered—something designed for bodies that aren't standard.
physical_description.fit: Slim through the hip and thigh, with a generous internal waistband featuring adjustment cords for micro-fitting. The knee and calf taper naturally, but memory-fiber panels create subtle gathers that expand laterally when worn by limbs in geometric flux. Sits high on the waist, contemporary professional cut.
physical_description.primary_material: Matte black synth-wool blend with embedded memory-fiber composite panels. The synth-wool provides structure and a refined finish; the memory-fiber is micro-textured and pressure-responsive.
physical_description.texture: Smooth matte finish on primary synth-wool surfaces. The memory-fiber panels are subtly quilted in a geometric diamond or honeycomb pattern, creating a tactile depth that catches light only at sharp angles. No sheen; all surfaces are subdued and professional.
physical_description.color_scheme: Solid matte black with minimal visual contrast. The memory-fiber panel quilting creates shadow-play rather than color variation—it reads as tonal depth rather than pattern.
physical_description.closures: High-security magnetic snap at waistband with redundant friction-fit closure. Side zip at ankle (both legs) for easy on/off with variable limbs. Internal adjustment cords at waist and hip for fine-tuning fit around non-standard leg geometries.
distinctive_features: Memory-fiber expansion panels at thigh, knee, and calf that deform and reform silently
Internal waistband adjustment cords with tension locks
Ankle-side magnetic zips for accessibility with augmented limbs
Reinforced stress-points at hip and knee for durability
Kelden manufacturer micro-etching at interior waistband
Subtle internal tech-routing channels for haptic feedback integration
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 luxury augmentation wear. The price point and engineering suggest corpo-class clientele with high-end cyber-limb augmentations.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by corpo executives, military cyber-enhanced operatives, and wealthy private augmentation clients. Signals someone whose body is valuable enough to customize—and whose customization is professional, not street-level. No rebellion in the aesthetics; this is seamless integration tech.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine or broken-in to soft comfort. The memory-fiber panels show no wear—they're designed for durability. Any visible condition would be from accident or combat, not from normal use.

Model standing in contrapposto pose to show limb geometry. Cinematic neon-lit urban interior, rain-slicked floor reflecting cool blue and violet light. Close detail shot of memory-fiber panel quilting on thigh, catching edge light. Dark gradient background, professional catalog styling. Moody, corporate-tech aesthetic. --ar 2:3 --v 6
